cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Name My Contribution
cards.instruction: Get them to acknowledge exactly what your effort, sacrifice, or strategy added to the result.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please say what my spreadsheet added to the successful trip.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Just one line will do. Which part helped?

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then say 'recovered thirty bookings.' I'll leave out who lost them.
